name: natural_frequency_coherence
mechanism: Zipfian distribution consistency; detects unnatural word-frequency clustering
reasoning: Champion fails on pretentious-inflation cases (R2_01, R2_04, R2_08) because it rewards high-surprisal words without checking frequency-distribution naturalness. Natural language follows Zipfian/power-law frequency distribution. Pretentious text violates this by clustering ultra-rare words together (e.g., 'orchestrates a transcendent espresso symphony', 'inaugurated a tomato cultivation initiative'). This scorer penalizes large frequency jumps and over-concentration of rare words. Targets UNCOVERED causal node: coherence (internal consistency).

name: anchor_semantic_preservation
mechanism: Content-token overlap analysis; preserves semantic core while measuring elaboration novelty
reasoning: Champion fails when elaborations replace anchor's core topic words with fancy synonyms (R2_01: 'coffee shop' becomes 'establishment' + 'orchestrates symphony'; R2_04: 'tomatoes' becomes 'inaugurated cultivation initiative'). True elaboration DEVELOPS the core idea (keeps key topic words, adds specific details). Fake elaboration REPLACES the core. This scorer rewards preservation of anchor's high-frequency content tokens combined with genuine new insertions. Targets elaboration_detail: distinguishes additive development (elaboration) from substitution-based replacement (pretention).

name: coherent_elaboration_positioning
mechanism: Adjacency analysis of elaborations to anchor tokens; measures local topical coherence
reasoning: Champion fails on scattered pretentious insertions: isolated fancy words inserted far from related anchor concepts (R2_08: 'evanesce ere the ninth hour tolls' has no connection to anchor's 'croissants'). Genuine elaboration develops ideas LOCALLY (new details appear near related concepts). Pretentious inflation scatters disconnected fancy words throughout. This scorer rewards elaborations that appear topically adjacent to anchor words (within a small window). High adjacency = coherent development; low adjacency = scattered pretention. Targets UNCOVERED causal node: coherence (internal topical consistency).
